gloss: loud sound; great noise; thunderous volume

definitions.gloss: loud sound; great noise; thunderous volume
definitions.explanation: An extremely loud sound or noise, emphasizing the overwhelming volume or intensity of the auditory impact.

examples.japanese: {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: A thunderous sound echoed all around.

examples.japanese: {花火|はなび}が{大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}とともに{夜空|よぞら}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Fireworks shot up into the night sky with a tremendous boom.

examples.japanese: コンサート{会場|かいじょう}では{大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}のため、{耳|みみ}{栓|せん}をしている{人|ひと}も{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: At the concert venue, many people were wearing earplugs because of the extreme volume.

notes:
Composed of {大|だい} (great; large) + {音響|おんきょう} (sound; acoustics). Describes a sound that is overwhelmingly loud, often to the point of being physically felt. Used in both literal descriptions of noise and more dramatic, literary depictions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}が{響|ひび}く: a great sound reverberates
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}とともに: with a great roar
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}を{立|た}てる: to make a great noise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {轟音|ごうおん}: roaring sound; thundering noise — emphasizes a rumbling, resonating quality
- {騒音|そうおん}: noise; noise pollution — implies unwanted or disturbing sound
- {爆音|ばくおん}: explosive sound — specifically the sound of explosions, engines, or similar blasts
